module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  output reg [4:0] q
);

  reg [4:0] lfsr;
  reg [2:0] tap_positions = 3'b111; // taps at bit positions 5, 3, and 1

  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
      lfsr <= 5'b11111; // initial state
      q <= 5'b1; // active-high synchronous reset
    end else begin
      lfsr[4] <= lfsr[3] ^ lfsr[1] ^ lfsr[0]; // shift right
      lfsr[0] <= lfsr[4] ^ tap_positions[0]; // XOR with tap at bit position 5
      lfsr[1] <= lfsr[4] ^ tap_positions[1]; // XOR with tap at bit position 3
      lfsr[2] <= lfsr[4] ^ tap_positions[2]; // XOR with tap at bit position 1
      q <= lfsr; // output the current state
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input in,
  input areset,
  output out
);

  reg [1:0] state = 2'b00; // Initial state is B

  always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) begin
      state <= 2'b00; // Reset to B
    end else begin
      case (state)
        2'b00: begin
          if (in) begin
            state <= 2'b01; // Transition to A
          end else begin
            state <= 2'b00; // Stay in B
          end
        end
        2'b01: begin
          state <= 2'b00; // Transition to B
        end
        default: begin
          state <= 2'b00; // Default to B
        end
      endcase
    end
  end

  assign out = state; // Output the current state

endmodule

	input signed [10:0] a,
	input signed [10:0] b,
	input signed [10:0] d,
	output [10:0] out,
	input clk);

reg [21:0] reg1; // 22-bit internal register

always @(posedge clk) begin
    reg1 <= a + d; // Pre-addition
    result <= reg1 * b; // Multiplication
    out <= result[10:0]; // Output the 11-bit result
end

endmodule

module dualportram #( parameter WIDTH = 64, parameter DEPTH = 6 ) (
    input wire clk_a,
    input wire we_a,
    input wire [DEPTH-1:0] addr_a,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] din_a,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] dout_a,
    input wire clk_b,
    input wire we_b,
    input wire [DEPTH-1:0] addr_b,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] din_b,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] dout_b
) begin
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] memarray [0:DEPTH-1];

    always @(posedge clk_a or posedge we_a) begin
        if (we_a) begin
            memarray[addr_a] <= din_a;
            dout_a <= din_a;
        end else begin
            dout_a <= memarray[addr_a];

    always @(posedge clk_b or posedge we_b) begin
        if (we_b) begin
            memarray[addr_b] <= din_b;
            dout_b <= din_b;
        end else begin
            dout_b <= memarray[addr_b];
        end
    end
endmodule

code:
module mem_ctl(
    input wire clk,
    input wire [31:0]addr,
    input wire [31:0]data,
    input wire we,
    input wire [1:0]access_width
) 
begin
    reg [31:0] data_reg;

    if (we) begin
        case (access_width)
            2'b00: data_reg <= data; // Byte access
            2'b01: data_reg <= {data[15:0], data[31:16]}; // Half-word access
            2'b10: data_reg <= {data[31:0], data[31:0]}; // Full-word access
            default: data_reg <= data; // Default to byte access
        endcase
    end

    // Debugging output
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (we) begin
            $display("Data written: %0h", data_reg);
        end
    end
endmodule

module delay_ctrl (
    input clk,
    input reset,

    input faster,
    input slower,
    output [3:0] delay,

    input write,
    input [7:0] writedata
) begin
    reg [3:0] delay_intern = 4'b1000;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            delay_intern <= 4'b1000;
        end else begin
            if (write) begin
                delay_intern <= writedata[3:0];
            end else begin
                if (faster) begin
                    if (delay_intern < 15) begin
                        delay_intern <= delay_intern + 1;
                    end
                end else if (slower) begin
                    if (delay_intern > 1) begin
                        delay_intern <= delay_intern - 1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    assign delay = delay_intern;
endmodule

    input [3:0] Columns,
    input [3:0] Rows,

    output reg [3:0] OnesDigit,
    output reg [3:0] TensDigit,

);

        9'b000000000, // Key 0
        9'b000000001, // Key 1
        9'b000000010, // Key 2
        9'b000000011, // Key 3
        9'b000000100, // Key 4
        9'b000000101, // Key 5
        9'b000000110, // Key 6
        9'b000000111, // Key 7
        9'b000001000, // Key 8
        9'b000001001, // Key 9
        9'b000001010, // Key 10
        9'b000001011, // Key 11
        9'b000001100, // Key 12
        9'b000001101, // Key 13
        9'b000001110, // Key 14
        9'b000001111, // Key 15
        9'b000010000, // Key 16
        9'b000010001, // Key 17
        9'b000010010, // Key 18

        9'b000010100, // Key 20
        9'b000010101, // Key 21

    assign TensDigit = 4'b0000;

    end

    end
end

module ALU(
    input [31:0] a,
    input [31:0] b,
    input [3:0] control,
    output reg [31:0] result,
    output zero
) begin
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
        if (~rst) begin
            result <= 0;
            zero <= 1;
        end else begin
            case (control)
                4'b0000: result <= a + b; // Addition
                4'b0001: result <= a - b; // Subtraction
                4'b0010: result <= a & b; // AND
                4'b0011: result <= a | b; // OR
                4'b0100: result <= ~a & b; // NAND
                4'b0101: result <= a ^ b; // XOR
                4'b0110: result <= a >> 1; // Right shift
                4'b0111: result <= a << 1; // Left shift
                default: result <= a + b; // Default to addition
            endcase
            zero <= (result == 0);
        end
    end
endmodule

module flipflop (
    input  clk,
    input  L,
    input  q_in,
    input  r_in,
    output reg Q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (L) begin
            Q <= r_in;
        end else begin
            Q <= {Q[1] ^ Q[2], Q[0], Q[2]};
        end
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input areset,
    input in,
    output out
);

    reg [1:0] state = 2'b00; // Initial state

    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            state <= 2'b00; // Reset to state B
        end else begin
            case (state)
                2'b00: begin
                    if (in) begin
                        state <= 2'b01; // Transition to state A
                    end else begin
                        state <= 2'b00; // Stay in state B
                    end
                end
                2'b01: begin
                    state <= 2'b10; // Transition to state B
                end
                2'b10: begin
                    state <= 2'b00; // Transition to state B
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign out = state[0]; // Output is the first bit of the state

endmodule

module Control(
		input clk,
		input start,
		output[3:0] direction,
		output ready
	);

reg [2:0] state;
reg [3:0] direction_out;
reg ready_out;

always @(posedge clk) begin
	if (start) begin
		state <= 3'b001; // Initialize state to 1
		direction_out <= 4'b0000; // Set direction to 0000
		ready_out <= 1'b0; // Set ready to 0
	end else begin
		case (state)
			3'b000: begin
				direction_out <= 4'b0001; // Set direction to 0001
				ready_out <= 1'b0; // Set ready to 0
			end
			3'b001: begin
				direction_out <= 4'b0010; // Set direction to 0010
				ready_out <= 1'b0; // Set ready to 0
			end
			3'b010: begin
				direction_out <= 4'b0011; // Set direction to 0011
				ready_out <= 1'b0; // Set ready to 0
			end
			3'b011: begin
				direction_out <= 4'b0100; // Set direction to 0100
				ready_out <= 1'b0; // Set ready to 0
			end
			3'b100: begin
				direction_out <= 4'b0101; // Set direction to 0101
				ready_out <= 1'b0; // Set ready to 0
			end
			3'b101: begin
				direction_out <= 4'b0110; // Set direction to 0110
				ready_out <= 1'b0; // Set ready to 0
			end
			3'b110: begin
				direction_out <= 4'b0111; // Set direction to 0111
				ready_out <= 1'b0; // Set ready to 0
			end
			3'b111: begin
				direction_out <= 4'b1000; // Set direction to 1000
				ready_out <= 1'b1; // Set ready to 1
			end
			default: begin
				direction_out <= 4'b0000; // Set direction to 0000
				ready_out <= 1'b0; // Set ready to 0
			end
		endcase
	end
end

assign direction = direction_out;
assign ready = ready_out;

endmodule

module ALU(
    output [31:0] ALU_o,
    input signed  [31:0] A, B,
    input  [3:0]  ALUSel
) 
begin
    // Define the multiplexer for the operation selection
    always @(*) begin
        case (ALUSel)
            4'b0000: ALU_o = A + B; // Addition
            4'b0001: ALU_o = A + ~B + 1; // Subtraction
            4'b0010: ALU_o = A << B[4:0]; // Shift left logical
            4'b0011: ALU_o = A >> B[4:0]; // Shift right logical
            4'b0100: ALU_o = A >>> B[4:0]; // Shift right arithmetic
            4'b0101: ALU_o = A ^ B; // XOR
            4'b0110: ALU_o = A & B; // AND
            4'b0111: ALU_o = A | B; // OR
            4'b1000: ALU_o = (A < B) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Comparison
            default: ALU_o = 32'b0; // Default operation
        endcase
    end

    // Define the COMP32b module to handle the comparison operation
    COMP32b comp32b_inst (
        .A(A),
        .B(B),
        .SLT(ALU_o[0])
    );
endmodule

module clock_divider(
input wire clock,
output wire clock_div
);
parameter input_freq = 100000000; // Input clock frequency in Hz
parameter output_freq = 50000000; // Output clock frequency in Hz

reg [31:0] counter; // Counter register to track input clock cycles
reg clock_signal; // Output clock signal

always @(posedge clock) begin
    if (counter == (input_freq / output_freq) - 1) begin
        counter <= 0; // Reset counter
        clock_signal <= ~clock_signal; // Toggle output clock signal
    end else begin
        counter <= counter + 1; // Increment counter
    end
end

assign clock_div = clock_signal; // Output the divided clock signal
endmodule

module alu(input signed [31:0] x, input signed [31:0] y, input [3:0] alu_ctrl, output reg signed [31:0] result, output reg zero);
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
        if (~rst) begin
            result <= 0;
            zero <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (alu_ctrl)
                4'b0000: result <= x + y; // Addition
                4'b0001: result <= x - y; // Subtraction
                4'b0010: result <= x * y; // Multiplication
                4'b0011: result <= x / y; // Division
                4'b0100: result <= x & y; // AND
                4'b0101: result <= x | y; // OR
                4'b0110: result <= x ^ y; // XOR
                4'b1000: result <= x < y ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Less than comparison
                4'b1001: result <= x > y ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Greater than comparison
                4'b1010: result <= x == y ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Equal comparison
                4'b1011: result <= x != y ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Not equal comparison
                default: result <= 0; // Default operation
            endcase
            zero <= result == 0;
        end
    end
endmodule

module PulseCounter(
input wire clk,
output wire pulse
);

parameter UPPER_BOUND = 28; // User-defined upper bound for the counter

reg [27:0] counter; // 28-bit counter
reg [27:0] next_counter; // Next counter value for the next clock cycle
reg [27:0] pulse_counter; // Counter for generating pulses

always @(posedge clk) begin
    next_counter <= counter + 1; // Increment the counter on each positive edge of the clock
    if (next_counter == UPPER_BOUND) begin
        pulse_counter <= pulse_counter + 1; // Increment the pulse counter when the counter reaches the upper bound
        pulse <= 1'b1; // Generate a pulse
        counter <= 0; // Reset the counter to zero
    end else begin
        pulse <= 1'b0; // No pulse generated
        counter <= next_counter; // Update the counter
    end
end

endmodule

module Start_UP_Handler(
input wire i_CLK,
output wire o_RST
);
parameter g_Clock_Frequency = 1000000; // Clock frequency in Hz
parameter g_Initial_Reset_Time = 100000; // Initial reset time in clock cycles

        r_RST <= 0; // De-assert reset after the specified time
    end else begin
        r_RST_Counter <= r_RST_Counter + 1; // Increment counter on each clock edge
    end
end

module BaudTickGen(
	input clk, enable,
	output tick  
);
parameter ClkFrequency = 1000000; // Input clock frequency in Hz
parameter Baud = 9600; // Desired baud rate in bits per second
parameter Oversampling = 4; // Oversampling factor for accuracy

// Internal registers and wires
reg [log2(Baud) - 1:0] Acc; // Accumulator to count clock cycles
reg [log2(Baud) - 1:0] Inc; // Increment value for the accumulator
reg [log2(Baud) - 1:0] Count; // Counter for the number of clock cycles
reg [log2(Baud) - 1:0] Overflow; // Flag to indicate overflow of the accumulator

// Clock division logic
always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (enable) begin
        Acc <= Acc + Inc; // Increment the accumulator
        Count <= Count + 1; // Increment the count
        if (Acc >= Baud * Oversampling) begin // Check for overflow
            Overflow <= 1; // Set the overflow flag
            Acc <= 0; // Reset the accumulator
        end
    end else begin
        Acc <= 0; // Reset the accumulator when enable is low
        Count <= 0; // Reset the count when enable is low
        Overflow <= 0; // Reset the overflow flag when enable is low
    end
end

// Tick generation logic
always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (Overflow) begin
        tick <= 1; // Generate the tick signal when the overflow flag is set
        Overflow <= 0; // Reset the overflow flag
    end else begin
        tick <= 0; // No tick signal when the overflow flag is not set
    end
end

endmodule

module db (
        input clk, n_reset, button_in,
        output reg out
    );

    parameter maxbit = 8; // Define the width of internal registers

    reg [maxbit-1:0] q_reg; // Internal register for the counter
    reg [maxbit-1:0] q_next; // Next state of the counter
    reg [maxbit-1:0] f1; // Capture the input state
    reg [maxbit-1:0] f2; // Capture the input state
    reg q_add; // Control signal for counter increment
    reg q_reset; // Control signal for counter reset

    always @(posedge clk or posedge n_reset) begin
        if (n_reset) begin
            q_reg <= 0; // Reset the counter
            f1 <= 0; // Reset the input capture
            f2 <= 0; // Reset the input capture
            q_add <= 0; // Reset the counter increment
            q_reset <= 0; // Reset the counter reset
        end else begin
            q_next <= q_reg + q_add; // Update the next state of the counter
            f1 <= button_in; // Capture the input state
            f2 <= f1; // Capture the input state
            q_add <= 0; // Reset the counter increment
            q_reset <= 0; // Reset the counter reset
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk or posedge n_reset) begin
        if (n_reset) begin
            out <= 0; // Reset the output
        end else begin
            if (q_reg == maxbit - 1) begin // Check if the counter has reached its maximum value
                out <= f2; // Update the output with the captured input state
            end else begin
                out <= 0; // Update the output with the current state
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

input S, R;

        state = 1'b1; // Set state to 1
    end else if (R) begin
        state = 1'b0; // Reset state to 0
    end
end

assign Q = state; // Output Q is the current state
assign NQ = ~Q; // Output NQ is the inverse of Q

module motor_rpm_count(
	input clk,
	input motor_rot_pulse,
	output wire [15:0]rpm_output
);

reg [31:0] pulse_count; // 32-bit countdown timer initialized to 50,000,000 - 1
reg last_scan_value; // 1-bit register to store the previous state of the motor rotation pulse
reg [15:0] pulse_count_qty; // 16-bit register to count the number of pulses
reg [15:0] output_count_qty; // 16-bit register to hold the output value

always @(posedge clk) begin
	if (pulse_count == 0) begin
		pulse_count_qty <= 0; // Reset pulse count when timer reaches zero
		output_count_qty <= 0; // Reset output count when timer reaches zero
		last_scan_value <= 0; // Reset last scan value when timer reaches zero
		pulse_count <= 50000000 - 1; // Reset countdown timer to 50,000,000 - 1
	end else begin
		if (motor_rot_pulse && !last_scan_value) begin
			pulse_count_qty <= pulse_count_qty + 1; // Increment pulse count when rising edge detected
		end
		last_scan_value <= motor_rot_pulse; // Update last scan value
	end
end

assign rpm_output = output_count_qty; // Output the measured RPM

endmodule

module hex_7seg(
input wire blank,
input wire [3:0] hex,
output reg [6:0] seg
);

always @(posedge blank or posedge hex) begin
    if (blank) begin
        seg <= 7'b0000000; // Blank display
    end else begin
        case (hex)
            4'b0000: seg <= 7'b1111111; // 0
            4'b0001: seg <= 7'b0000110; // 1
            4'b0010: seg <= 7'b1011011; // 2
            4'b0011: seg <= 7'b1001111; // 3
            4'b0100: seg <= 7'b1100110; // 4
            4'b0101: seg <= 7'b1110011; // 5
            4'b0110: seg <= 7'b1111100; // 6
            4'b0111: seg <= 7'b0111111; // 7
            4'b1000: seg <= 7'b1110111; // 8
            4'b1001: seg <= 7'b1111110; // 9
            default: seg <= 7'b0000000; // Default pattern for invalid inputs
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule
